# jira_permission_scheme (Resource)

Manages a Jira permission scheme. Permission schemes control what users and groups can do within projects that use the scheme.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "jira_permission_scheme" "project_editors" {
  name        = "Project Editors"
  description = "Permission scheme for project editors"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the permission scheme

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the permission scheme

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import jira_permission_scheme.example 12345
```
